fact: The e-Governance Academy says its experts supported ANSIE in setting up a national data exchange layer and trained staff to deploy and work with the solution on national scale, in a project run May 2022 to April 2023 and marked finished; the page does not say the layer is live.

The e-Governance Academy says a functional and integrated X-Road secure data exchange with PKI was implemented for ANSIE between government registries and databases, and that the government of Djibouti has the X-Road data exchange system in place; the date is the project's end month, taken from the published date.

The director general of the population directorate says it is working on an interoperability system that will let public administrations, and some institutions such as banks and social protection bodies, check a national ID card's authenticity in real time; no launch is stated.
